description: Vehicle 1 is traveling straight in the right hand lane of a 4 lane road. A sequence of 6 cones forms a mild chicane within Vehicle 1’s lane: cones alternate between being near the right edge and near the left edge, but always leave at least half the lane width passable. Vehicle 2 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1 in the adjacent lane; Vehicle 2 changes lanes into Vehicle 1’s lane after the last cone. Vehicle 3 is traveling straight in the opposite direction (oncoming relative to Vehicle 1).
